test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Statements:

All songs are melodies.

Some melodies are tunes.

All tunes are rhythmic.

Conclusions:

I. Some melodies are rhythmic.

II. All songs may be tunes.
solution:
Least possible Venn diagram,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4ae450185f135372ebd7e1a4708afb8138555caf02b4aaa56d189c0f24cf333.png] 

**Conclusions:** **

I. Some melodies are rhythmic → **Follow** (As all tunes are rhythmic and some melodies are tunes. so, some melodies are definitely rhythmic)

II. All songs may be tunes → **Follow **(There is not direct relation given between songs and tunes. it is possibility that all songs may be tunes but not definite).

Both I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3**”.
